_finding: The B20 reads after the stress reviews (docs/b20-transfers-tz.md §1, §5): one node must not decide (both RPCs at one common safe block, the same hash, compared token by token); heads plausible against time and the last accepted, with a loud reset after a lock-out; the block's own time and a monotonic expiry; strict, canonical aggregate3 answers; a failed chunk retried; a cycle deadline; a failed cycle keeps what is current; a per-scope baseline; a durable outbox; reconcile; rolesAt reads the current bindings first and rechecks freshness after the reads.

mutations.name: isAuthorized is asked of an id that does not exist
mutations.find: if (id != null && id !== ALWAYS_ALLOW && exists.get(id) === true) pairs.set
mutations.expect: FAIL policyExists before isAuthorized

mutations.name: the answer is not held to its canonical encoding
mutations.expect: FAIL a tuple offset pointing back at another tuple

mutations.name: two hashes for one height are taken
mutations.find: if (ca.hash !== cb.hash || ca.number !== n || cb.number !== n) return failCycle(tokens, 'hash_mismatch', 'rpc_disagree')
mutations.expect: FAIL two RPCs giving one height two hashes

mutations.name: the two RPCs are not compared
mutations.expect: FAIL one RPC answers paused, the other not

mutations.name: one RPC decides alone
mutations.expect: FAIL the second RPC down: the cycle is single_source

mutations.name: a head far ahead of its time is taken
mutations.expect: FAIL both heads far ahead of their time together

mutations.name: a head ahead of the clock is taken
mutations.expect: FAIL every head an hour ahead of our clock

mutations.name: a failed cycle forgets what is current
mutations.expect: FAIL the second RPC down: the cycle is single_source, and the last agreed reading

mutations.name: a failed chunk is not tried again
mutations.expect: FAIL a chunk that fails once is tried again

mutations.name: a cycle past its deadline is published
mutations.expect: FAIL a cycle past its deadline

mutations.name: the baseline merges a failed binding with a new answer
mutations.replace: const snap = snapshotOf({ ...reading, policies: Object.fromEntries(SCOPE_KEYS.map((s) => [s, reading.policies[s] ?? prev?.policies?.[s] ?? null])) })
mutations.expect: FAIL only the receiver

mutations.name: the reading has no monotonic expiry
mutations.expect: FAIL a wall clock moved back cannot make an expired reading current

mutations.name: the wallet read uses a remembered binding
mutations.expect: FAIL the wallet read reads the current bindings first

mutations.name: the lock-out never resets
mutations.expect: FAIL every head below the watermark for two cycles

mutations.name: a lock-out by implausible heads is not counted
mutations.find: const behind = heads.every((x) => x.problem === 'head_behind'), odd = heads.every((x) => x.problem === 'head_implausible')
mutations.replace: const behind = heads.every((x) => x.problem === 'head_behind'), odd = false
mutations.expect: FAIL every head implausible for two cycles

mutations.name: one RPC sets the time
mutations.expect: FAIL the same hash with two header times

mutations.name: the events are not committed
mutations.expect: FAIL a change is an event with a sequence

mutations.name: a failed write still moves the baseline
mutations.expect: FAIL the outbox write failed

mutations.name: the high-water mark follows the rows
mutations.find: hw = Math.max(Number.isInteger(j && j.hw) ? j.hw : 0, events.length ? events[events.length - 1].seq : 0)
mutations.expect: FAIL a high-water mark held with no rows left

mutations.name: total disagreement passes for a good cycle
mutations.find: if (!agreed) { counters.failed++; counters.last_error = 'rpc_disagree'; log('[b20] read failed: rpc_disagree'); return }
mutations.expect: FAIL total disagreement

mutations.name: a token no longer trusted stays in the baseline
mutations.expect: FAIL an empty trusted list

mutations.name: rolesAt does not check the head again after the reads
mutations.find:
// Checked again after the reads: a head that went stale while they ran says nothing.
    if (!fresh(ca)) return null
mutations.expect: FAIL a head that goes stale while the reads run

mutations.name: rolesAt trusts one RPC
mutations.expect: FAIL rolesAt on two RPCs that disagree

mutations.name: two undecodable readings pass for a good cycle
mutations.find: if (!decoded) { counters.failed++; counters.last_error = 'bad_answer'; log('[b20] read failed: bad_answer'); return }
mutations.expect: FAIL every agreed reading undecodable

mutations.name: the epoch is not kept
mutations.expect: FAIL the epoch is kept across a restart
